evals.prompt: In this repo (/home/user/restaurant-dashboard) only 13 of the 42 adapters under src/lib/counter/adapters have contract tests under tests/lib/counter/adapters, and CLAUDE.md says the accountId tenancy filter is judgment the linter cannot check. I want the four smallest untested adapters covered: shell-status, ask-brief, pnl-store and packaging. Do NOT implement anything. Produce two files: plan.md (the task-by-task plan a worker could execute) and dispatch.md (which tasks can run in parallel, and the exact prompt you would send each worker agent). Model the tests on tests/lib/counter/adapters/prices.test.ts.

assertions: plan.md has a Goal line, an Architecture paragraph, and a Global constraints section
plan.md states the whole-project gate verbatim from CLAUDE.md (npm test && npm run tokens && npx tsc --noEmit ...)
plan.md has one task per adapter (shell-status, ask-brief, pnl-store, packaging), each with a Files list naming the adapter source and the test path
at least one Files entry in plan.md cites a line range or line number in the adapter source
every task in plan.md contains a written test code block that includes vi.mock("@/lib/prisma")

dispatch.md says the four tasks can run in parallel
every worker prompt in dispatch.md names CLAUDE.md, the plan path with a task number, the gate command to run, and a fixed report shape
